h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Katni

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Katni

items.pText: Katni, in the Mahakoshal region of Madhya Pradesh, is a railway junction known for its limestone and cement industry, and is often called the lime city. Colony parks, factory townships and schools here ask us for play areas, and many want something for adults too. FunPlay Systems makes both playground and outdoor gym equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 920 km away, and sends it by road.

A park where parents can exercise while their children play tends to be used more often than one built for children alone. Our Fun Fitness range includes outdoor gym machines such as walkers, twisters and leg presses, which can sit beside the play area. We plan both on one layout drawing, with separate zones and a clear path between them. Katni's summers are hot and its monsoon steady, so we plan shade and drainage for both zones.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Combining a play area and an outdoor gym

c: Keep the gym zone close enough for parents to watch the play area, but separate it with a path or a low hedge so small children do not wander into moving machines. Put the toddler equipment on the side nearest the gym, since that is where parents will be. Choose simple machines that adults of any age can use, such as a walker or a seated twister. Add benches between the two zones for grandparents who prefer to sit and watch.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 920 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply a playground and an outdoor gym for the same park?
items.a: Yes. We make both and plan them on one layout drawing, with separate zones, a clear path between them and seating where parents can watch their children.

items.q: Should children use outdoor gym machines?
items.a: Outdoor gym machines are designed for adults, and children should play on their own equipment. Separating the two zones with a path or hedge helps keep small children away from moving parts.
Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Katni by road, and our installation team or a dealer in Madhya Pradesh installs it according to your approved layout.
